name: Rias Gremori
source:
I met Rias last month, as well as [url=https://vndb.org/c152921]Akeno[/url]. Since then, [url=https://vndb.org/c144573]Sammy[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]I[/url] have started taking requests from her for monsters and demons. We already know each other well, and there are clearly feelings between us. I think we will soon be able to open up to each other and share everything in our hearts. But for now, I need to focus on solving my sisters' problems.
